tasks.label: Build and launch TBASwift simulator
args: xcrun simctl boot 1FC82A4A-577F-46FC-8EE1-3FD67D83B0A9 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; open -a Simulator; xcrun simctl bootstatus 1FC82A4A-577F-46FC-8EE1-3FD67D83B0A9 -b && xcodebuild -quiet -project TBASwift.xcodeproj -scheme TBASwift -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,id=1FC82A4A-577F-46FC-8EE1-3FD67D83B0A9' -derivedDataPath /tmp/TBASwiftDerivedData build && xcrun simctl install 1FC82A4A-577F-46FC-8EE1-3FD67D83B0A9 /tmp/TBASwiftDerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/TBASwift.app && (xcrun simctl terminate 1FC82A4A-577F-46FC-8EE1-3FD67D83B0A9 com.tba.TBASwift >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && xcrun simctl launch 1FC82A4A-577F-46FC-8EE1-3FD67D83B0A9 com.tba.TBASwift
